timeline.text: Welcome to Overwhelmed by My To-Do List. I’ll guide you through each tapping point. At every point, you’ll hear a short phrase. Repeat it aloud, or quietly inside your head. Let’s begin.

timeline.ins: Begin tapping on the side of your hand.
timeline.say: There is too much to do.

timeline.ins: Now tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: Everything feels urgent.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I do not know where to start.

timeline.ins: Now tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: My mind keeps jumping between tasks.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: I can feel this pressure in my body.

timeline.ins: Now tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I am afraid I will fall behind.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: I am judging myself for feeling stuck.

timeline.ins: Now tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I can admit I feel overwhelmed.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: I cannot carry everything at once.

timeline.text: Take one easy breath. Notice whether anything has shifted, even slightly. If nothing has changed yet, that’s completely okay. Keep breathing, and we’ll continue.

timeline.ins: Return to the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I can pause before I choose.

timeline.ins: Tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: Not everything is equally urgent.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I only need one next step.

timeline.ins: Tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I can let the other tasks wait their turn.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body is allowed to soften.

timeline.ins: Tap under your nose.
timeline.say: Progress can be small and still count.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: Feeling overwhelmed does not mean I am failing.

timeline.ins: Tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I can choose what matters most right now.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: I can put down the rest for a moment.

timeline.text: Take another slow breath. Notice what feels different now. You do not need the feeling to disappear. See if there is simply a little less pressure, or a little more choice in how you meet this moment.

timeline.ins: Return to the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I am ready to begin one thing.

timeline.ins: Tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: I can work at a human pace.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I trust myself to choose the next step.

timeline.ins: Tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I can return when my mind wanders.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My attention can settle here.

timeline.ins: Tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I do not need to finish everything today.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: One completed step creates momentum.

timeline.ins: Tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I can be focused without being frantic.

timeline.ins: Finish under your arm.
timeline.say: I know what I will do next.

timeline.text: Let your hands rest, and take one full breath. Notice how you feel now, without needing to judge it. Thank you for taking this time for yourself. Carry this steadiness with you as you continue.
